(Sydney)

Tata Consultancy Services is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for the last fifty years. TCS offers a consulting-led, Cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of IT, Business & Technology Services, and engineering. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development. A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group,

About the role:

HR Business Partner will be reporting to the Head of Talent Management and Engagement, Human Resources. This position will be in Sydney, Australia. The selected candidate is expected to carry out the role of an HR business partner by enabling employee relations, promoting engagement, providing coaching, and advisory to managers on various HR policies and processes, and supporting global HR initiatives for the business unit. An ideal candidate would have between 8-10 years of similar experience in a mid to large size organization. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Providing proactive HR advice and guidance to the leadership team and employees of the unit.
•	Advising and assisting managers in implementing HR processes and policies. 
•	Ensuring all managers and employees understand the company policies and procedures, applying them fairly and consistently.
•	Advising managers on all matters related to employee relations and ensuring compliance with employer obligations on an ongoing basis. 
•	Suggesting, developing, and owning all people-related initiatives/improvement processes to its roll-out and on-going compliance thereafter.
•	Undertaking additional duties as required on request to meet the needs of the business units.
•	Enabling continuous collaboration with other HR teams across the organization on an ongoing basis on all people related initiatives.
•	Responsible for timely completion of performance management activities, appraisal processes and conducting awareness workshops for employees. 
•	Driving usage of career management platforms in the system and participation in mentoring programs for employees in the unit.
•	Organizing and partnering with managers at the unit level Townhalls and leadership programs. 
•	Ensuring continuous communication with managers and employees across all HR related matters including regular visits to client locations for in-person employee-HR connects. 
•	Organizing employee engagement programs including awareness programs and workshops across employee wellbeing. 
•	Implementing and driving organizational and geography level Corporate Social Responsibility and Diversity & Inclusions programs. Customizing and conducting engagement interventions suited to unit’s requirements. 
•	Conducting analysis for employee feedback through Employee Satisfaction Survey the organization, creating and implementing Action Plan for the unit. 
•	Responsible for addressing employee grievance, ensuring discussions with employees and relevant stakeholders towards closure of grievance in the system as per the prescribed timelines. 
•	Preparing reports and analysis on various areas such as employee engagement programs, attrition, timesheet management on monthly and quarterly basis for the unit. 


 How to apply:

TCS is an equal opportunity employer. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality.
